title: camat web-edition site config
description: Config of camat-build-site (camat.web_edition), version 1. Paths are relative to the config's folder. The build checks more than this schema: that files exist, work ids are unique, URLs are http(s) or relative, and the MEI matches the facsimile.

$schema.description: URL or path of this schema, for editors; the build ignores it.

title.description: Page title, and the heading unless heading is given.

heading.description: Heading above the score. Default: title.

lang.description: Language tag of the page (<html lang>). It does not translate the interface; see labels.

storage_prefix.description: Prefix of the browser storage keys. Give each site on the same host its own.

footer.description: Text above the credits line: text, or a list of text and {text, url} links.

labels.description: Interface words. Other interface text is English.

hint.default: Hover a bar or a symbol to see its bar number and xml:id.

label.description: Name in the tabs or select. Default: id.

title.description: Name in messages. Default: labels.work and label.

mei.description: Path of the MEI file; file names must differ between works.

work_menu.description: Default: select when there are more than 8 works.

verovio.description: Verovio options, merged over camat's defaults.

ref_base.description: Base URL for relative <ref target> links in the notes.

url.description: An http(s) URL or a relative link.

pdf.description: true: visitors may open their own copy of the PDF; {url, text} also says where to get it.

images.description: Page images: copied into the site (copy: true) or hosted at url.

url.description: https folder with the images under their names in pages.json.

confirm.description: Notice; the images appear only after the visitor confirms it.

button.description: Label of the button that shows the images.
